name: 作物收获手测夹具（DTMAPI）
author: DTMAPI QA
description: 开发者手测夹具。依赖 DTMAPI Runtime，仅调用 ICropHarvestingApi 扫描和收获作物容器目标；不发布到 Workshop。

localized_description.schinese: 开发者手测夹具。通过 DTMAPI CropHarvesting API 扫描普通、藤蔓、菌包、灌木、乔木盆和草/采集类目标；只执行 API 当前允许的 PlantBasin-family 收获路径。
localized_description.tchinese: 開發者手測夾具。透過 DTMAPI CropHarvesting API 掃描普通、藤蔓、菌包、灌木、喬木盆與草/採集類目標；只執行 API 目前允許的 PlantBasin-family 收穫路徑。
localized_description.english: Developer-only manual QA fixture. Scans ordinary, vine, mushroom-bag, bush, tree-basin, and grass/forage crop-container targets through ICropHarvestingApi, and only executes the currently allowed PlantBasin-family harvest path.
